tasks.title: Database Migration Planning
tasks.description: Plan migration from legacy MySQL to PostgreSQL for transactional data and MongoDB for product catalog. Need to design data migration strategy and ensure zero downtime. This is critical as all other backend tasks depend on this.
tasks.notes: Must complete before any backend development. Risk of data loss if not done properly. Need database expert consultation. BLOCKER for all backend tasks.

tasks.title: Setup CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Setup automated CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins. Containerize all services with Docker. Deploy to Kubernetes cluster on AWS. Implement blue-green deployment.
tasks.notes: BLOCKER - Without this, deployments will be manual and error-prone. Should be done early to enable continuous deployment.

tasks.title: Setup Authentication Service
tasks.description: Implement OAuth2 authentication service with JWT tokens. Use Redis for session management. This will be used by all microservices for user authentication and authorization.
tasks.notes: Security critical. Must implement rate limiting and token refresh. All API endpoints will depend on this. BLOCKER for all user-facing features.

tasks.title: Setup Monitoring and Logging
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. Setup centralized logging with ELK stack. Error tracking with Sentry.
tasks.notes: Should be done early to monitor system health. Critical for production debugging.

tasks.title: Implement Inventory Management
tasks.description: Build inventory management system with real-time stock tracking. Handle stock reservations during checkout. Prevent overselling.
tasks.notes: Race condition risks. Need distributed locking with Redis. Critical for order fulfillment.

tasks.title: Payment Gateway Integration
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe and PayPal payment gateways. Must be PCI-DSS compliant. Handle payment webhooks, refunds, and failed transactions. Critical for revenue generation.
tasks.notes: HIGH RISK - Payment security is critical. Need security audit. Blocking checkout functionality.

tasks.title: Implement API Rate Limiting
tasks.description: Implement API rate limiting using Redis. Protect against DDoS attacks and abuse. Different limits for authenticated vs anonymous users.
tasks.notes: Security critical. Must be implemented before public launch.

tasks.title: Setup Database Backups and Disaster Recovery
tasks.description: Implement automated database backups to AWS S3. Setup disaster recovery procedures. Test restore process.
tasks.notes: CRITICAL - Data loss prevention. Need regular backup testing. Compliance requirement.

tasks.title: Migrate Frontend to React
tasks.description: Migrate legacy jQuery frontend to modern React with TypeScript. Implement Redux for state management. This is a major refactor affecting all UI components.
tasks.notes: Large effort. Risk of breaking existing functionality. Need comprehensive testing. Will block all UI improvements.

tasks.title: Implement Product Search with Elasticsearch
tasks.description: Implement full-text search using Elasticsearch. Sync product data from MongoDB. Support filters, facets, and autocomplete.
tasks.notes: Performance critical. Need to handle large product catalog (1M+ products). Elasticsearch cluster setup required.

tasks.title: Implement Caching Layer
tasks.description: Implement multi-level caching with Redis for API responses and CDN for static assets. Setup Nginx as reverse proxy with caching.
tasks.notes: Performance optimization. Need cache invalidation strategy. Risk of serving stale data.

tasks.title: Implement Order Management System
tasks.description: Build order management system with order creation, tracking, cancellation, and refunds. Use RabbitMQ for async processing. Integrate with inventory and payment systems.
tasks.notes: Complex business logic. Multiple integration points. Risk of order processing failures.

tasks.title: Implement Shopping Cart
tasks.description: Build shopping cart functionality with persistent storage in Redis. Handle cart abandonment. Support guest checkout.
tasks.notes: Core e-commerce feature. Need to handle concurrent cart updates.

tasks.title: Build Admin Dashboard
tasks.description: Create admin dashboard for managing products, orders, users, and analytics. Real-time updates using WebSockets.
tasks.notes: Depends on React migration. Need role-based access control.

tasks.title: Build Notification Service
tasks.description: Build notification service for emails and SMS. Use SendGrid for emails and Twilio for SMS. Queue notifications with RabbitMQ.
tasks.notes: Need to handle notification failures and retries. Rate limiting required.

tasks.title: Performance Testing and Optimization
tasks.description: Conduct load testing with JMeter. Identify bottlenecks using New Relic. Optimize database queries and API endpoints.
tasks.notes: Should be done after major features. May reveal architectural issues requiring refactoring.

tasks.title: Security Audit and Penetration Testing
tasks.description: Conduct security audit following OWASP guidelines. Perform penetration testing. Fix identified vulnerabilities. Implement security headers.
tasks.notes: CRITICAL - Must be done before production launch. May reveal security issues requiring immediate fixes.

tasks.title: Setup Analytics and Tracking
tasks.description: Implement analytics tracking with Google Analytics and Mixpanel. Use Segment for event tracking. Track user behavior and conversions.
tasks.notes: Important for business insights. Privacy compliance required (GDPR).

tasks.title: Implement Product Recommendations
tasks.description: Build ML-based product recommendation engine using TensorFlow. Store recommendations in Redis. Update based on user behavior.
tasks.notes: Nice-to-have feature. Requires ML expertise. Can be done later.

tasks.title: Mobile App Development
tasks.description: Develop mobile app for iOS and Android using React Native. Reuse Redux logic from web app. Implement push notifications.
tasks.notes: Large effort. Requires mobile development expertise. Can be done in parallel with web development.
